title: Read-only distribution_outbox triage: no dead-letter class approved for replay

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Anchor moved during branch synchronization on 2026-08-30. The original anchor was cb4581c8241a2b302aa456f53194d108998d3f6a (the substantive branch head as authored on 2026-08-26). The lane had fallen 39 commits behind main and was synchronized via the non-rewriting PR update path (gh pr update-branch 1452) onto main at 4f7ae5109325fc11999f77e8b57adc20ba7cdccd, producing merge commit 4e912e88b175d3bdacb4e0b4c7b9063c7a137890. That merge commit is now the last commit touching any path outside PROOF_ONLY_PREFIXES (docs/06_status/proof/, docs/06_status/lanes/); every commit after it changes only the lane manifest heartbeat and these proof artifacts. No lane history was rewritten: all seven original lane commits remain ancestors of the new head. evidence_commit_sha and current_pr_head_sha are resolved by CI.

verdict.statement: No dead-letter class is approved for replay. replayVerdict has no reachable approving branch and TriageReport.anyClassApprovedForReplay is typed as the literal false.

production_target.note: The local CLI path is unavailable under production containment (local.env carries SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1). Live reads were issued through the Supabase MCP read path. Every statement was a SELECT.

lane_tests.detail: Each control proven by making it fail on the condition it names. Wired into test:ops so the suite runs under required verify. That wiring edits package.json, which the lane's trusted (first-commit) file_scope_lock snapshot does not declare, so the advisory File scope lock check fails. No scope-override/v1 comment exists on PR #1452; an earlier revision of this bundle wrongly described the widening as PM-authorized and that claim is withdrawn.

corrections_made_in_lane: The first draft filtered the read with .neq('status','delivered'). Production has no 'delivered' status; the terminal status is 'sent'. The filter matched nothing and pulled all 3758 terminal rows into the triage read. Fixed to .in('status',['pending','processing','dead_letter']) and pinned by two regression tests.
scope_refusals: Read-only. The only database verb issued is SELECT.
No replay, requeue, release, delete, regrade, or backfill.
The 1954 dead letters are never to be replayed or modified.
Cleanup of the 32 orphaned processing rows and 3 pending canary rows is out of scope and belongs to a separate bounded successor.

branch_synchronization.method: gh pr update-branch 1452 (non-rewriting; no rebase, no admin merge)
branch_synchronization.conflicts: none — git merge-tree --write-tree reported no conflicted paths
branch_synchronization.production_counts_note: All row counts in this bundle remain the 2026-08-26 read against zfzdnfwdarxucxtaojxm. The read-only classifier was deliberately NOT re-run during synchronization, so no fresher numbers were substituted for the evidence the verdict was formed on. The verdict does not depend on population size: replayVerdict has no reachable approving branch.

known_gaps: Advisory File scope lock fails on package.json (trusted first-commit snapshot). Not a required check; clearing it needs an externally authored scope-override/v1 comment, which is PM's to grant.
Advisory Return review packet fails for the same scope reason.
